The command to record it is: ```bash node scripts/verify-review-verdict.mjs --record --reviewer claude --model claude-sonnet-4-6 --evidence-file /tmp/pr1770-claude-review.md ``` --- ## Review: PR #1770 — Quota Governor (R4-BUG-005 step 2) **Source SHA:** `1ab12887cf6e6fef0e5a43db5d46f150343a17de` **Base:** `2d080ab8b189c869dc8684851e71aea63c108547` **Model:** `claude-sonnet-4-6` **Blocking findings:** 0 **Verdict: PASS** --- ### Security boundaries **`/api/quota/status` auth gate.** The route handler is placed at ~line 21210, after the existing `isValidToken` check at ~21183–21194. Unauthenticated callers receive 401 before reaching the quota handler. `cache-control: private, no-store` is set unconditionally. Only `GET` is served; other methods return 405. `sendJson(_quotaGovernor.status())` outputs only IDs, labels, units, counts, and times — no keys, URLs, or ledger paths. Source-text assertion `doesNotMatch(serialized, [...forbidden...])` including `'never-expose-fixture'`, `'apiKey='`, `'https://'`, `process.env.LOCAL_API_TOKEN`, `'filePath'`, and key names. Mutation `leak-auth-status` drops 1 of 2 route tests. Mutation `public-status` (adds to `PUBLIC_API_ROUTES`) also drops 1 test. **Local-only target.** `/api/quota/status` is added to `LOCAL_ONLY_API_TARGETS` in `runtime.ts`, preventing cloud fallback from substituting local accounting data. Mutation `remote-quota-fallback` drops 1 of 2 fallback tests. **Windows zero/missing safe flags fail closed.** Both `O_NOFOLLOW` and `O_NONBLOCK` are checked `> 0` before any disk read is attempted. Zero or undefined values skip disk reads silently and log a warning; in-process accounting continues. No unsafe path-based fallback. Mutations `omit-supported-flags` (removes the check), `omit-nofollow-support`, and `omit-nonblock-support` each cause 2–4 test failures in the 72-pass governor suite. No Windows restart claim is made. --- ### Fail-open provider votes `fetchWithTimeout` wraps `transportFetchWithTimeout`. After transport returns, it may call `response.text()` for body-needing providers (PurpleAir, Anthropic), then calls `_quotaGovernor.observe()`. The returned response object is unchanged. The transport builds responses from a closure-captured `body` string (fully collected by `boundedResponseCollector` before the Promise resolves), so callers' subsequent `.json()` or `.text()` are unaffected by the governor's body read. Provider adapters derive their `ok` votes from the response they receive. Mutation `skip-observed-body` (passes `undefined` body) drops 1 test; `skip-observation` drops 4; `allow-denied` drops 13; `skip-admission` drops 21. --- ### Interactive priority isolation `_quotaPriority` is an `AsyncLocalStorage`. It is set only inside `runInteractiveQuota()`. Background calls use `_quotaPriority.getStore() ?? 'background'` — `getStore()` returns null outside of an `run()` context. Exactly 3 `runInteractiveQuota(() =>` call sites exist: credential verifier, VT lookup, GreyNoise single-IP lookup. GreyNoise batch uses background priority. The concurrent-overlap test verifies a live interactive call does not grant its priority to a concurrent background call. Mutations `leak-interactive-priority` (hardcodes `'interactive'`), `drop-verifier-interactive`, `drop-grey-interactive`, and `drop-vt-interactive` each drop 2–13 tests. --- ### Ledger security | Property | Implementation | Mutation detecting it | |---|---|---| | Symlink prevention | `O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK` open | `ledger-follow-ledger-symlink` (−2 tests) | | File mode | `openSync(tmp, 'wx', 0o600)` | `ledger-world-readable-ledger` (−2 tests) | | Atomic replace | temp UUID file + `renameSync` | `ledger-publish-failed-partial-file` (−2 tests) | | Bounded read | fstatSync size check + maxBytes+1 growth detection | `ledger-ignore-growth-bound` (−1 test) | | TOCTOU-safe read | fd-based, no path re-open after validation | `ledger-reopen-path-after-validation` (−2 tests) | | Short-write loop | loop until all bytes written | `ledger-stop-after-short-write` (−2 tests) | | Zero-progress guard | throws and unlinks temp on no progress | `ledger-publish-zero-progress-write` (−1 test) | | Coalescing delay | 1s default, explicit flush cancels timer | `ledger-leave-pending-flush` (−1 test) | | Future bucket limit | FUTURE_SKEW_MS = 60s | `ledger-accept-future-buckets` (−1 test) | | Cooldown clamping | min(cooldownUntil, t + maxWindowMs) | verified in tamper test | Failed writes log a warning, keep the prior good ledger file, and do not add a blocking policy. Oversized ledger serialization skips disk write; in-memory accounting continues. --- ### Recovery requires validated acquisition **Not HTTP 200 alone.** Recovery (`recordFeedSuccess` + `trackSuccess`) is called only after: - NewsAPI: items array passes `isPersistedNewsEnvelope` and acquisition succeeds - AbuseIPDB: response array passes IP validation, all entries have valid `ipAddress` - PurpleAir: `sensors.length > 0` or `validEmpty` check passes - OpenSky: `usable` check on states array passes - GreyNoise: only when `results.length === SEED_IPS.length` (full batch) Each omit-recovery mutation drops exactly 1 test. `quotaExhaustedResponse` calls failure records, not recovery. `recover-on-common-stale` mutation (adds recovery inside stale path) drops 2 tests. Cache hits do not refresh `lastSuccess` (advance+fetch test verifies unchanged timestamp). --- ### Stale data handling `quotaExhaustedResponse` returns stale with HTTP 200 and `X-Quota-State: stale_quota`. Absence of stale returns HTTP 503 with `{ error: 'quota_exhausted', ... }`. Valid empty arrays (e.g., AbuseIPDB with zero entries) are served as stale correctly — `reject-valid-empty-stale` mutation (requires `.length > 0`) drops 4 tests. Stale observation times preserve original cache timestamps: `observedAt: _sidecarCache.get('opensky:states:all').ts`. Mutation `erase-stale-observation` (uses `Date.now()`) drops 1 test. Stale data never overwrites saved acquisition metadata in the quota cache. --- ### PurpleAir memory-only Uses `setCached(cacheKey, result, 5 * 60 * 1000)` (in-memory TTL cache), not `_quotaCache` (persisted disk cache). Stale fallback reads `getCachedStale(cacheKey)` from memory. Requests include exactly 8 fields (`sensor_index,pm2.5,latitude,longitude,location_type,confidence,name,last_seen`) with no `max_age` parameter. Isolation proofs: - `omit-existing-location-field` (removes `location_type`): −2 isolation tests - `restore-unverified-maxage` (adds `max_age=3600`): −3 tests - `restore-deferred-hourly-cadence` (1h cache): −4 tests - `restore-persisted-response` (uses `_quotaCache.set`): **−6 tests** - `restore-legacy-disk-read` (uses `_quotaCache.get` for read): −4 tests --- ### OpenSky shared snapshot Three global consumers (`/api/adsb`, `/api/adsb-military`, `/api/aviation/flights`) share `getOpenskyStatesSnapshot()` via `_openskySnapshotPending` promise coalescing. The fourth route (`/api/adsb-aggregate`) makes its own separate transport call and never reads from or writes to the shared snapshot. Mutations `lose-global-coalescing` and `retain-settled-global-promise` each drop 1 test. Stale `observedAt` uses the cache entry timestamp. Malformed or all-rejected states throw before `setCached`. --- ### UI schema — fail closed `parseQuotaStatus` returns `null` on: empty providers, >64 providers, `targetShare !== 0.8`, timestamps > 8.64e15 or negative, text > 80 chars, duplicate provider IDs, ceiling > limit, null limit with non-null ceiling, unsupported state strings, `estimate`/`unverified`/`observeOnly` not booleans. Unknown fields are excluded from the parsed record. Each omit-guard mutation in the UI schema drops exactly 1 of the 13 quota-budgets tests. HTML escaping: `escapeHtml` is applied to all label, unit, state, host, and reason strings. Mutation `unsafe-html` (replaces `escapeHtml` with identity) drops 1 test. The E2E test verifies `` appears as literal escaped text with zero `` elements in `.syd-quota`. --- ### UI controller lifecycle Single-flight (`pending` guard), 30-second refetch throttle (`finishedAt`), abort on deactivation, 5-second timeout abort, generation guard prevents stale completion, `disposed` flag prevents post-destroy activity. All verified by mutation proofs. Web-only mode returns `{ ok: false, error: 'desktop sidecar required' }` immediately without fetching. `fetchStatus` uses `cache: 'no-store'` and passes the caller's `AbortSignal`. --- ### Advisory text accuracy The rendered UI includes accurate statements about: - "usage counts, not provider responses" (not full responses) - "PurpleAir responses remain memory-only" - "best-effort local ledger may restore recent counts on supported platforms; unwritten counts can be lost" - "Unsupported safe-file reads are ignored" - "not a hard reserve or spend guarantee" - "Explicit key tests and lookups are counted but not blocked by the app" Mutations `false-persistence-copy` (substitutes "Counts survive restarts") and `false-interactive-copy` (substitutes "All requests are blocked") and `lose-ledger-response-distinction` (removes "not provider responses") each drop 1 test. --- ### CI wiring E2E spec added to `test:e2e:interactions:ci` and `tests/e2e-ci-coverage.test.mjs` inventory (count 9→10). Sidecar CI inventory count 62→66 (four new governor test files). `test:quota-ui` covers both `tests/quota-governor-gates.test.mjs` and `src/services/diagnostics/__tests__/quota-budgets.test.mts`. `test:news-resilience` added as an override for `local-api-server.mjs` changes. All confirmed by wiring-proof mutations. --- ### What I could not verify - Actual test execution on this exact branch (coordinator's QA attestation provides 8449 passes, zero failures). - Native app launch or live provider interaction. - E2E browser tests in a real browser (coordinator attestation covers 32/32 interaction specs including 3/3 quota subset). --- ### Outstanding acceptance — explicit ruling **The original Round 4 24-hour/five-restart live soak has not been performed and is not waived.** This does not block merging this bounded implementation. The soak tests live-provider reliability and real network behavior. This PR implements and proves the core admission, persistence, observation, recovery, and UI machinery with 121 mutation proofs and comprehensive unit/integration/browser tests. `QUOTA_GOVERNOR_DESIGN.md` and `SECURITY_SCAN_ROUND_4_FOR_CODEX.md` both explicitly record that original #1770 completion remains open and the soak remains a requirement for the full-completion claim — not for this bounded delivery. Merging does not assert the soak has been done. --- **Zero blocking findings. PASS.**
